中文

问题修复
- 修复**真机上端口复用从未生效**的问题:读取 unit 端口的命令是 `grep -E '--port [0-9]+'`,GNU grep 会把以 `--` 开头的模式当作选项而报错,导致端口读不到、每次 `up` 都重新分配端口(登记表因此一行行堆积)。现在模式前加了 `--` 终止选项解析;同时让 mock 的 grep 复刻 GNU 的选项解析行为,这类"只有真机会犯"的 bug 无法再被测试放过。此后 `up` 会输出 `reusing registered remote port N` 并复用已登记端口
- `down` 现在除了停止 unit 还会 **disable** 它:此前 enabled 的 unit 会在服务器重启后自己拉起,占用一个登记表已标记 released 的端口(audit 里的 ORPHAN 行就是这么来的)。`up`/`provision` 会重新 enable;`--keep-service` 行为不变
- 登记表查询改为取**最新一行**:登记表是追加式的,同一端口的旧 `released` 行会遮蔽当前 `in-use` 行——表现为隧道明明在跑,`status` 却显示 released;`audit --release <端口>` 也可能改到历史行而非当前行
- 心跳只刷新 `in-use` 行,历史 released 行不再被"刷新"成刚活跃过的样子

体验优化
- `up` 把一次性启动地址(`authUrl`)写入本地状态文件,`open` 优先使用它:此后单独执行 `dsh --profile remote open <host>` 也能直接打开页面,而不是在 dsh web ≥ 0.1.2-rc 上收到 401
- `status`(CLI 与 `/remote status`)在已知时显示 `auth:` 地址

其他变更
- mock `ssh` 补齐 GNU grep 选项解析与登记表心跳规则,测试行为与真实服务器对齐

---

English

Bug Fixes
- **Port reuse never worked on real servers**: the unit port probe ran `grep -E '--port [0-9]+'`, and GNU grep parses that pattern as an option and fails, so the ExecStart port came back empty and every `up` allocated a fresh port (which is also why the registry grew one row per `up`). The pattern now follows `--`, and the mock's grep reproduces GNU option parsing so this class of bug cannot hide again. `up` reports `reusing registered remote port N` and keeps the registered port
- `down` now **disables** the unit as well as stopping it: an enabled unit came back after a server reboot and re-occupied a port the registry had already marked released (the ORPHAN rows seen in `audit`). `up`/`provision` enable it again; `--keep-service` is unchanged
- Registry lookups use the **newest** row for a port: the registry is append-ordered, so an older `released` row could shadow the live `in-use` row — `status` showed "released" while the tunnel was up, and `audit --release <port>` could rewrite history instead of the effective row
- Heartbeats only refresh `in-use` rows, so historical released rows no longer look freshly alive

Improvements
- `up` stores the one-time launch URL (`authUrl`) in the local state file and `open` prefers it, so a later `dsh --profile remote open <host>` reaches the page instead of answering 401 on dsh web ≥ 0.1.2-rc
- `status` (CLI and `/remote status`) shows the `auth:` URL when one is known

Chores
- The mock `ssh` mirrors GNU grep option parsing and the registry's in-use heartbeat rule, keeping the tests aligned with the real server
